svg.aria-label: About me. Dilemma: We can reduce the chances of dying, but you can never reduce them to zero. Waifu: Hatsune Miku (needless to mention). Color: #39C5BB. Fuel: leeks, instant ramen and manga. Dream: Earth's orbit and maybe other planets. Final boss: an AGI called The Director. Buffs: Hatsune Miku 100% fan, leek power max, kawaii level infinite.
